course.title: Python Data Science
course.subtitle: From arrays to answers
course.description: Learn data analysis with Python: NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, statistics, SQL, web data and interactive dashboards, practiced on one fictional company's data.
course.prerequisite: Introduction to Programming with Python and Intermediate Python (or equivalent)

modules.title: Start Here
modules.description: Set up Python, a virtual environment and Jupyter, download the course data, and run your first analysis.

lessons.title: Your Data Science Toolkit
lessons.description: Install Python, build a virtual environment, meet notebooks and scripts, and run a first analysis on the Pinecrest data.

modules.title: NumPy Fundamentals
modules.description: The array: the data structure underneath pandas, Matplotlib, SciPy and nearly everything else in this course.

lessons.title: Arrays vs Lists
lessons.description: Why NumPy arrays are smaller and faster than lists, and how to create, inspect, index and copy them.

lessons.title: Vectorized Operations
lessons.description: Replace loops with whole-array arithmetic, comparisons, boolean masks and aggregations.

lessons.title: Broadcasting
lessons.description: How NumPy combines arrays of different shapes, and how to read a shape error.

lessons.title: Random Number Generation
lessons.description: Seeded generators, sampling and simulation with numpy.random.default_rng.

lessons.title: Linear Algebra Essentials
lessons.description: Vectors, matrices, dot products and solving linear systems with numpy.linalg.

modules.title: Pandas
modules.description: Load, clean, reshape, combine and summarize real tables of data.

lessons.title: DataFrames and Series
lessons.description: The two core pandas objects: creating, selecting, filtering and adding columns.

lessons.title: Loading Data
lessons.description: Read CSV, Excel, JSON and SQL into DataFrames with the right types from the start.

lessons.title: Cleaning Data
lessons.description: Fix missing values, duplicates, inconsistent labels, bad dates and text-as-numbers in a messy export.

lessons.title: GroupBy Operations
lessons.description: Split, apply, combine: summarize by store, category and customer.

lessons.title: Merging and Joining
lessons.description: Combine tables on keys, choose the right join, and catch rows that do not match.

lessons.title: Pivot Tables and Reshaping
lessons.description: Pivot, melt, stack and crosstab to move between long and wide data.

lessons.title: Time Series
lessons.description: Datetime indexes, resampling, and handling gaps in daily data.

lessons.title: Window Functions
lessons.description: Rolling, expanding and exponentially weighted calculations, ranks and shifts.

lessons.title: Feature Engineering Basics
lessons.description: Turn raw columns into useful features: bins, dates, ratios, encodings and customer summaries.

modules.title: Visualization with Matplotlib
modules.description: Build clear charts with the object-oriented Matplotlib interface.

lessons.title: Line, Scatter and Bar Charts
lessons.description: The three workhorse charts and when each one is the right choice.

lessons.title: Subplots and Composition
lessons.description: Lay out several axes in one figure and make them read as a whole.

lessons.title: Customizing Plots
lessons.description: Titles, labels, ticks, colors, annotations and styles that make a chart say one thing clearly.

lessons.title: Saving Figures
lessons.description: Export figures at the right size, resolution and format for reports, slides and the web.

modules.title: Statistics for Data Analysis
modules.description: Describe data honestly, quantify uncertainty, and test claims without fooling yourself.

lessons.title: Descriptive Statistics I: Center and Spread
lessons.description: Mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation and when each one misleads.

lessons.title: Descriptive Statistics II: Shape, Position and Outliers
lessons.description: Skew, percentiles, z-scores, outlier rules and summaries by group.

lessons.title: Probability Distributions
lessons.description: Normal, binomial, Poisson and friends with scipy.stats, plus sampling distributions.

lessons.title: Correlation Analysis
lessons.description: Pearson and Spearman, what correlation hides, and a confound hiding in the store data.

lessons.title: Hypothesis Testing
lessons.description: Null hypotheses, p-values, effect sizes, t-tests, chi-square and their assumptions.

lessons.title: A/B Testing
lessons.description: Plan a sample size, analyze the checkout experiment, and avoid peeking.

lessons.title: An EDA Workflow
lessons.description: A repeatable routine for exploring a new dataset from first look to written findings.

modules.title: SQL and Databases
modules.description: Query a relational database from Python, then meet a document database.

lessons.title: Database Connections
lessons.description: Connect to SQLite with sqlite3 and SQLAlchemy, run safe parameterized queries, and load results into pandas.

lessons.title: Complex Queries
lessons.description: Joins, subqueries, CTEs (including a recursive one) and CASE expressions.

lessons.title: SQL Window Functions
lessons.description: Running totals, rankings and comparisons to previous rows with OVER.

lessons.title: Query Optimization
lessons.description: Read EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN, add an index, and measure the difference.

lessons.title: NoSQL with MongoDB
lessons.description: Documents, queries and aggregation pipelines with PyMongo on nested session data.

modules.title: Getting Data from the Web
modules.description: Collect data politely from web pages and APIs.

lessons.title: HTTP with Requests
lessons.description: Requests, responses, status codes, headers, timeouts and robots.txt.

lessons.title: Parsing HTML with Beautiful Soup
lessons.description: Select elements, follow pagination and turn a practice catalog into a DataFrame.

lessons.title: Dynamic Pages with Selenium
lessons.description: Drive a real browser, wait for JavaScript content, and know when you do not need to.

lessons.title: API Authentication
lessons.description: API keys, bearer tokens, token expiry and keeping secrets out of your code.

lessons.title: Rate Limiting and Retries
lessons.description: Respect 429 and Retry-After, back off, cache, and be a polite client.

modules.title: Interactive Visualization and Dashboards
modules.description: Statistical graphics, interactive charts and a small data app.

lessons.title: Statistical Graphics with Seaborn
lessons.description: Distributions, relationships and categories with seaborn's figure-level and axes-level functions.

lessons.title: Interactive Charts with Plotly
lessons.description: Hover, zoom and filter with Plotly Express and graph objects.

lessons.title: Interactive Charts with Bokeh
lessons.description: Linked plots, tools and widgets in the browser with Bokeh.

lessons.title: Dashboards with Streamlit
lessons.description: Turn an analysis into a small interactive web app.

modules.title: Capstone
modules.description: One end-to-end analysis, from question to written findings.

lessons.title: The Pinecrest Report
lessons.description: Question, data, cleaning, exploration, a test, charts and a short written report, with a rubric.
